description: The receipts behind the free Caller Report Card: the most recent 100 Robinhood Chain calls by one X handle, each with its post id and URL, capture time, attribution basis, pool, the three prices its grade is made of (at the call, 30 min before, 1 h after), the pre-run and one-hour move, the grade (early / momentum / neither) or why there is none (pending, ungradeable, unmarked, not_admitted), plus token outcome (real or dead, current FDV); true total and truncation flag. Calls preserved as captured — deleting the post does not scrub the record. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base. (paid $0.02, or included in a RobinX plan key — see instructions)
name: robinx_caller_calls
